method: Score = 2 x need (runway <4Q=3, <6Q=2, <9Q=1) + window (catalyst within 4 months = 1; 1M run-up >30% or 3M >60% = 2) + 1 if the company sold stock worth >10% of its cap in the last four reported quarters + 1 if executable (cap >=$150M and ADV >=$1M; else -2). Shown if score >=4. Size = ~18 months of burn, bounded to 10-30% of market cap. View: Participate = our call is Long/Strong Buy with science >=3; Short into the deal = Short call; Pass = Avoid or weak science.
